copy.headline: A wave of emotions for TCU after Dykes firing then a quick trip to No. 9 Texas Tech
copy.caption: TCU interim head coach Andy Avalos says the Horned Frogs are now focused on their regular-season finale after the wave of emotions following Sonny Dykes' firing.
